newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia cuts internal coffee price by 5.12 pct.
newsitem.headline: Colombia cuts internal coffee price by 5.12 pct.

text.p: Colombia lowered its internal coffee by 5.12 percent Friday, setting it at 363,750 pesos per 125-kg load, the National Coffee Growers' Federation said.

The cut was the first since Dec. 5 when the internal price was set at 221,500 pesos per 125-kg load. The price had been raised six times since Jan. 31, as the federation moved to bring internal prices closer into line with world prices.
The new price, which should hold for at least 10 days, was based on average Colombian coffee prices in New York over the past week of $2.14 per pound, the federation said in a statement.
